rationale: Specific questions for a web project (e.g., website build, landing page).

required.prompt: What is the primary goal? (e.g., generate leads, sell products)

optional.prompt: List all required pages (e.g., Home, About, Contact)
CMS preference? (e.g., Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Custom)
Who will host? (e.g., Netlify, Vercel, Client's AWS)
SEO requirements? (e.g., basic on-page, full audit)
Is text/image content ready? (Yes / No / In Progress)
